institution: Universitat Oberta de Catalunya (UOC) — joint with Universitat Ramon Llull (La Salle)
programme_name: Máster Universitario en Ingeniería de Telecomunicación / Màster universitari d'Enginyeria de Telecomunicació
ruct_code: 4316386 (current UOC title; earlier codes 4312552 and 3500090 also registered to UOC for this title family) — code NOT printed on the programme page at access date, taken from output/ruct-backbone.jsonl, so treat as UNCONFIRMED against the page
start_date_verbatim: UOC-wide rule (uoc.edu/es/estudios/acceso-matricula/matricula-masters-posgrados-especializaciones): 'Matriculación a partir de abril para empezar el curso en septiembre u octubre' / 'Matriculación a partir de noviembre para empezar el curso en febrero o marzo'. The programme page itself showed only 'Inici: 23 set 2026' at access date.
start_month: February (or March) for the second semester cohort; September/October for the first
application_deadline_for_spring_intake: NOT FOUND as a specific date. UOC states only that matriculation for the February/March start opens in November; no closing date published on the pages read.
language_of_instruction: Català, Castellà (bilingual; classes shared) — verbatim from the Catalan programme page. NOT English.
tuition_total_eur: EUR 20.42/ECTS for EU students plus EUR 18.30/ECTS 'recursos d'aprenentatge'; non-EU quoted approx. EUR 5,790 total (full-time, 18 months) or approx. EUR 6,580 (part-time, 3 years) — rates shown on the page at access date, year of rates not stated on page
evidence_verbatim: 'Matriculación a partir de noviembre para empezar el curso en febrero o marzo'
notes: 90 ECTS. This is the strongest structural spring candidate in path C: UOC is the one Spanish university whose ENTIRE official master's catalogue runs on two teaching-start semesters. CAVEAT recorded honestly: the UOC-wide two-start rule is primary-sourced, but the telecom master's own page displayed only the September start at access date, so per-programme February availability is INFERRED from the institution-wide rule and needs a human to confirm with UOC admissions. Language is a hard filter for this candidate (Catalan/Spanish only, A0/A1 Spanish). Access page states up to 18 ECTS complementos de formación for non-telecom entrants — a Software Engineering degree would likely trigger them.

sources.field: start date shown on programme page, ECTS, language, price, complementos
